audit.why: Packet levelChart (Skill, Leona x5, Skill) matches content win[] exactly: level 1 is even pre-E, Leona's E dash-stun chain owns levels 2-6 and first item, and the lane returns to skill late once her damage stops scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[0..6].side are all 'Skill', but content win[1..5]='Leona' and the packet levelChart agrees — the full chart's middle rows never got updated.
audit.why: Leona's E dash-stun opens a full CC chain Bard has no dash to escape from levels 2 through first item; content's whys already state this correctly and match the packet's real-game data.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[1,2,3,4,5].side to 'Leona' with matching why rewrites; phases[0,6] already read 'Skill', agreeing with win[0,6], so left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable interactions are missing from the page: Leona's Q (Shield of Daybreak) and W (Eclipse) both absorb burst — never stated; and her combo opens with a Q auto-attack reset, so the wind-up animation is the real tell, not the ability cast — also never stated.
audit.why: The kit flags confirm Q/W as shield-type (absorbs burst, changes all-in math) and Q as an auto-attack reset (burst timing tell).
audit.corrected: Worked the shield fact into tradeBad and the auto-reset tell into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields misgender Leona (she/her) as 'his'/'he': tldr, dosFull[2].t, report[0].t, report[9].t.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists Leona as female; the owner is addressed as 'you' so third-person pronouns refer to the enemy.

edits.before: - Leona Zenith Blade: matchup-defining — The blade root starts every Leona chain — stand behind minions while it is up. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Magical Journey banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Leona Zenith Blade (E, 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s cd): her Q auto-reset is the real tell — watch the wind-up, not the cast, and stand behind minions once E is up. - Keep your E Magical Journey banked. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Full kit: shrine the sustain, tunnel the angles, and Q the geometry.
